name: Simeoni 2004 preclinical xenograft PK/PD TGI model (transit-chain cell death)
description: The canonical preclinical tumor-growth-inhibition model. Proliferating tumor x1 grows exponential-to-linear; drug at concentration E damages proliferating cells at rate k2*E, and damaged cells traverse a signal-distribution transit chain x2->x3->x4 (first-order rate k1) before dying, producing delayed cell death. Observed tumor weight w = x1+x2+x3+x4. Parameter values are the published paclitaxel / A2780 ovarian-xenograft estimates from Simeoni 2004 (experiment 3), as reproduced in the open-access Stromberg & Hooker 2017 reproduction (PMC5660732, Table I); units mouse-scale (1/day, grams, concentration in ng/mL). The implied tumor-static concentration is Ct = lambda0/k2 ~ 494 ng/mL. review_status remains 'unverified' pending a human read of the original Table (source is a secondary reproduction); see docs/verification/workhorse-models.md SS3. PRECLINICAL: applying to humans is the translation gap (see preclinical_translation.ivive_potency) and floors to D.
